# ez_logging  (`#include "ez_logging.h"`)

This is the header file for logging module.

Logging module provides user with multi-level and multi-format logging. Originally, logging will use printf to print file on the console, but it can be tailored to other IO

## Functions

### `Logging_DemoFeatures`

```c
void Logging_DemoFeatures(void);
```

This function demostrates some features of logging module.

Prints one test message per level (trace, debug, info, warning, error, critical) and a hex dump, using the EZxxx macros. Its source file defines DEBUG_LVL as LVL_ERROR, so only the error and critical messages are printed. The body exists only if EZ_LOGGING is 1U.

- **Pre:** None
- **Post:** None
- **See:** EZINFO
- **See:** EZHEXDUMP
